title.zh: 一步的规律就是一步的全部规律：在每个条件下与跨运行，一个模式（含给予者）恰在服从该条件的规律时由某个世界显示；容量添一条规律，活动不添
title.en: The laws of one step are all the laws of one step: under each condition and across runs, a pattern, its givers included, is shown by some world exactly where it obeys that condition's law; capacity adds one law and activity none

claim.zh: 一步在一个条件处所显示的是它的通过（Passage、Flow.passage）：步前与步后的层级，以及参与者从它取用与给它的总量。一步在一个家族上显示一个模式（Flow.Realizes），即其成员的通过依次排列、取用者的个数（Flow.takers）以及是否有参与者交换（Flow.ExchangesAt）。每一步都服从每步之律（Flow.Realizes.every）：凡有所取，取用者至少一个且至多所取之量，凡有所取或所给，就有交换。一个模式恰在服从每步之律时，由某个世界跨某步在某个家族上显示，每个参与者列出一次（OneStep.every_iff）；在被平衡的家族上，恰在每个通过还各自平衡时（OneStep.balance_iff）；在耗减的家族上，恰在总量下降至少取用者之数时（OneStep.runsDown_iff）；在跨此步封闭的家族上，恰在除非对家族有取或给否则无交换时（OneStep.closed_iff）；两个条件都有时，恰在两条律都成立时（OneStep.runsDownClosed_iff）。不论取用者之数，一个家族的通过恰在平衡且凡有所取总量至少降一时能够耗减（OneStep.runsDown_passages_iff）。所以模式的一个性质在条件成立的每一步成立，恰在它对服从该条件之律的每个模式成立时（OneStep.laws），这是 counting_laws 的对应。跨一个家族的每一步，只多一条律：通过前后相接，每步之后所立就是下一步之前所立（OneStep.Chained）；一串模式恰在通过相接且每步服从该条件之律时由某个世界显示（OneStep.run_every_iff、OneStep.run_balance_iff、OneStep.run_runsDown_iff、OneStep.run_closed_iff、OneStep.run_runsDownClosed_iff；OneStep.run_laws），这是 tally_iff_counted 的对应。一个见证世界服务每个模式（OneStep.Witness，经 World.ofRoles 读成脊柱的世界）。把给予者加入模式（P79b）：给予家族的东西有给予它的关系项，有所给之处给予者至少一个，至多为所给之数（Flow.sign_replenishment_le_renewers、Flow.renewers_le_replenishment、OneStep.Givers）；在无条件、平衡与封闭之下这就是全部新规律，耗减恰再加每个给予者都取，给予者不多于取用者（Flow.DissipatesOn.renewers_le_takers；OneStep.every_givers_iff、OneStep.balance_givers_iff、OneStep.closed_givers_iff、OneStep.runsDown_givers_iff、OneStep.runsDownClosed_givers_iff、OneStep.laws_givers）。该步的容量恰添所给不超过容量乘给予者数（Flow.CapacityAt.replenishment_le；OneStep.every_capacity_iff 及其四个同伴）；该步只有活跃者给予、只从所汲取者取，不添一步所显示的规律（OneStep.every_active_iff 及其四个同伴）。带给予者的一个家族上的运行：经过彼此相接，每步遵守带给予者的规律（OneStep.run_every_givers_iff 及其四个同伴）。不加前提。
claim.en: What the step from t shows of a condition is its passage (Passage, Flow.passage): its level before and after, and what the relata taking part take from it and give to it. A step shows a pattern on a family (Flow.Realizes): the passages of its members in order, how many relata take from it (Flow.takers), and whether something taking part exchanges (Flow.ExchangesAt). Every step obeys the law of every step (Flow.Realizes.every): where anything is taken from a family, the relata taking are at least one and at most what is taken, and where anything is taken or given something exchanges. A pattern is shown by some world across some step on some family, listing each relatum taking part once, exactly when it obeys the law of every step (OneStep.every_iff); on a family balanced on, exactly when each passage also balances (OneStep.balance_iff); on a family running down, exactly when moreover the total falls by at least the relata taking (OneStep.runsDown_iff); on a family closed across the step, exactly when moreover nothing exchanges unless something is taken from or given to the family (OneStep.closed_iff); with both conditions, with both laws (OneStep.runsDownClosed_iff). Whatever the count, a family's passages can run down exactly when they balance and the total falls by one wherever anything is taken (OneStep.runsDown_passages_iff). So a property of patterns holds of every step where a condition holds exactly when it holds of every pattern obeying that condition's law (OneStep.laws), the counterpart of counting_laws. Across every step of one family there is one more law: the passages follow one another, what stands after each step being what stands before the next (OneStep.Chained); a run of patterns is shown by some world exactly when its passages follow one another and each step obeys the condition's law (OneStep.run_every_iff, OneStep.run_balance_iff, OneStep.run_runsDown_iff, OneStep.run_closed_iff, OneStep.run_runsDownClosed_iff; OneStep.run_laws), the counterpart of tally_iff_counted. One witness world serves every pattern (OneStep.Witness, read as a world of the spine through World.ofRoles). With the givers in the pattern (P79b): something given to a family has a relatum giving it, the givers numbering at least one wherever anything is given and at most what is given (Flow.sign_replenishment_le_renewers, Flow.renewers_le_replenishment, OneStep.Givers); that is the whole new law under no condition, balance and closure, and running down adds exactly that every giver takes, the givers at most the takers (Flow.DissipatesOn.renewers_le_takers; OneStep.every_givers_iff, OneStep.balance_givers_iff, OneStep.closed_givers_iff, OneStep.runsDown_givers_iff, OneStep.runsDownClosed_givers_iff, OneStep.laws_givers). Capacity at the step adds exactly that what is given is at most capacity times the givers (Flow.CapacityAt.replenishment_le; OneStep.every_capacity_iff and its four companions); only active relata giving and taking only from what is drawn on, at the step, add no law that one step shows (OneStep.every_active_iff and its four companions). Runs on one family with givers: the passages follow one another and each step obeys its law with givers (OneStep.run_every_givers_iff and its four companions). No premise.

hypotheses.zh: 不加前提：每个刻画都是双向的，对每个模式成立；见证世界每个参与者列出一次。
hypotheses.en: No premise: each characterization is two-way and holds for every pattern; the witness world lists each relatum taking part once.

hypotheses.zh: 运行只在跨每一步固定的一个家族上刻画；逐步选择家族的情形（Locality 的 RunsDown 所允许的）没有刻画。
hypotheses.en: Runs are characterized on one family fixed across every step; families chosen step by step, as Locality's RunsDown allows, are not characterized.

correspondence.zh: P79（工作板），按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“move towards 100%”：强意义上的完备，即一类规律是该类的全部规律，此前只对计数成立（tally_iff_counted，P34）；这里对 Locality（P48）的一步之律给出。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：加上下面两条遗漏之律后，一步之律就是全部；跨运行唯一多出的律是所立的连续。见整合文档 §103。
correspondence.en: P79 (work board), following Ren's “move towards 100%” of 12 October 2026: completeness in the strong sense, the laws of a kind being all its laws, held before for counting only (tally_iff_counted, P34); here for Locality's (P48) laws of one step. Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): with the two missing laws below added, the laws of one step are all of them; across runs the only further law is the continuity of what stands. See the integration document §103.

detail.zh: 复用 Locality 的 BalancesOn、RunsDownOn、ClosedAt 与所陈述的一步之律；这里证明它们（加两条）是全部。
detail.en: Reuses Locality's BalancesOn, RunsDownOn, ClosedAt and the stated laws of one step; here they are proved, with two more, to be all.

input.en: The completeness of the laws of one step.

detail.zh: 计数的全部规律（tally_iff_counted、counting_laws）的对应：同样以精确刻画与见证世界回答。
detail.en: The counterpart of the whole law of counting (tally_iff_counted, counting_laws): answered the same way, by an exact characterization and a witness world.

output.en: The method of completeness for counting.

input.en: Completeness of the laws of one step.

detail.zh: 同一模块中所发现的两条遗漏之律。
detail.en: The two missing laws found in the same module.

detail.zh: 逐步选定家族的运行在另一记录中。
detail.en: Runs on families chosen step by step are in the other record.

detail.zh: 所陈述的律允许而没有世界显示的模式（OneStep.stated_not_realized、OneStep.standing_bound_needed）。
detail.en: Patterns the stated laws allow and no world shows (OneStep.stated_not_realized, OneStep.standing_bound_needed).

limitations.zh: 计数活跃的关系项、或参与而不交换的关系项不在模式中（需要活动可判定）；容量与活动只在一步上陈述，不在运行上；读法是 AI 的，待 Ren；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: Counting active relata, or relata taking part without exchanging, is not in the pattern (it would need activity decided); capacity and activity are stated at one step, not over runs; the readings are the AI's, pending Ren; no ethical predicate occurs.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261013T091820.375259Z）：Becoming.OneStep 的 311 项定理全部空依赖，其中含 Passage、Flow.passage、Flow.Realizes、OneStep.every_iff、OneStep.balance_iff、OneStep.runsDown_iff、OneStep.closed_iff、OneStep.runsDown_passages_iff、OneStep.laws、OneStep.Chained、OneStep.run_every_iff、OneStep.Givers、Flow.sign_replenishment_le_renewers、Flow.renewers_le_replenishment、Flow.DissipatesOn.renewers_le_takers、Flow.CapacityAt、Flow.ActingAt、Flow.TakingAt、OneStep.every_givers_iff、OneStep.runsDown_givers_iff、OneStep.every_capacity_iff、OneStep.every_active_iff、OneStep.laws_givers与 OneStep.run_every_givers_iff；同一回执覆盖包内 74 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 4328 项定理／6131 项声明审计，22 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致；外围回执 20261013T091907.838571Z 通过。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 76 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。作者反审见整合文档 §103；尚无独立审查。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T091820.375259Z): the 311 theorems of Becoming.OneStep all have empty axiom reports, among them Passage, Flow.passage, Flow.Realizes, OneStep.every_iff, OneStep.balance_iff, OneStep.runsDown_iff, OneStep.closed_iff, OneStep.runsDown_passages_iff, OneStep.laws, OneStep.Chained, OneStep.run_every_iff, OneStep.Givers, Flow.sign_replenishment_le_renewers, Flow.renewers_le_replenishment, Flow.DissipatesOn.renewers_le_takers, Flow.CapacityAt, Flow.ActingAt, Flow.TakingAt, OneStep.every_givers_iff, OneStep.runsDown_givers_iff, OneStep.every_capacity_iff, OneStep.every_active_iff, OneStep.laws_givers and OneStep.run_every_givers_iff. The same receipt covers the package's 74 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4328 theorems/6131 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T091907.838571Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 76 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §103 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.
